fusions.name: Hiss and Spit
fusions.desc: Spits at the first enemy in its path up to 6 tiles away, dealing 4 damage. It has 30% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Quiet Pounce
fusions.desc: You leap to a target up to 6 tiles away and rake it for 13 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Belly to the Ground
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks when you attack. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Righting Reflex
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
